content.comment_body: Hi everyone, I have an [product_name] module connected to my [product_name] controller. Although the software indicates there should be output voltage, I'm not measuring any. Is there a wiring detail that's missed in the manual? Currently, I have 24V supplied to the L+ and M terminals and I'm checking voltage at the two leftmost output terminals using a voltmeter. Thanks!

Hello, If you're measuring between v1+ and M1 and sending a value from 0 to 1000 to aq1, you should get a range between 0 to 10 V. Make sure the module is running and properly connected; also, check the slider setting. Regards,

V1+ and M? I thought those were for inputs, but I checked them anyway and still didn't get a reading. The RUN/STOP indicator is green. I also tried reconnecting and checked the slider, but there's no change.
I'm running this setup just for testing.

Hello, The [product_name] module only has output terminals for 0-10V and 0-20mA. You can refer to the attached diagram for correct connection. Also, check the properties to see how AQ1 is set—it might be configured for 4 to 20 mA instead of voltage. Make sure it's set for 0-10V or 0-20mA. To confirm, do you have an [product_name] module? What is the [article_no]? Regards,
I've followed the drawing for all connections. The [article_no] is [article_no]. Still not getting any voltage output.
After cycling the power, the module started working. So, it seems the issue is resolved.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered a problem where an [product_name] module did not output voltage as expected, despite software configuration. Troubleshooting revealed confusion about wiring and output type settings. Ultimately, the module began working only after a power cycle, highlighting the need for clearer setup instructions, better feedback on hardware status, and possibly regular manual resets to resolve such issues.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] module to consistently provide the configured voltage, with straightforward wiring and setup instructions that are clearly documented in the manual.
